title: Generating unfoldings of the hypercube
summary: A C++ enumerator for all unfoldings of the n-dimensional hypercube, representing each unfolding as a (tree, perfect matching) pair up to isomorphism and using nauty to generate trees and their automorphism groups, computed out to dimension 10. Meridian is mining it for a reusable canonicalize-and-dedup pattern for graph-structured records at scale.
